title: Application of Eastern Edison Company under th provision of G. L. c. 64, § 94G, as amended by St. 1981, c. 375 and the Company's tariff, M.D.P.U. 115, for approval by the Department of Public Utilities of a change in the Fuel Charge to be billed to Company's customers pursuant to meter readings in the billing months of March, April and May 1986. The fuel charge reflects costs of fuel and power purchased by the Company. Application is also made by Eastern Edison Company for approval by the Department of rates to be paid to Qualifying Facilities for purchase of power pursuant to 220 C.M.R. 8.00. The rules established in 220 C.M.R. 8.00 set forth in filings to be made by utilities with the Department, and implement the intent of sections 201 and 210 of the Public Utility Regulatory Policies Act of 1978.
